newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Fujitsu can't account for stock rise.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu can't account for stock rise.

text.p: Fujitsu Systems Business (M) Bhd said on Monday that it cannot account for a recent sharp increase in its stock price.
Shares of the distributor of computers and computer products were suspended on Monday for a company announcement.
In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, Fujitsu said there is no material development in its business and affairs that has not been previously disclosed.
Its stock closed at 15.20 ringgit on Friday.
